testdata/rept.asm:
    1                                           rept 2
    2                                             ld a, $i
    3                                             rept 2
    4                                               nop
    5                                             endr
    6                                             ld hl, $i
    7                                           endr
    7                                         + $COUNT = 2(0x2)
    7                                         + $I = 0(0x0)
    7  0000 3e 00                    [ 7]     +   ld a, $i
    7                                         + $COUNT = 2(0x2)
    7                                         + $I = 0(0x0)
    7  0002 00                       [ 4]     +     nop
    7                                         + $COUNT = 2(0x2)
    7                                         + $I = 1(0x1)
    7  0003 00                       [ 4]     +     nop
    7  0004 21 00 00                 [10]     +   ld hl, $i
    7                                         + $COUNT = 2(0x2)
    7                                         + $I = 1(0x1)
    7  0007 3e 01                    [ 7]     +   ld a, $i
    7                                         + $COUNT = 2(0x2)
    7                                         + $I = 0(0x0)
    7  0009 00                       [ 4]     +     nop
    7                                         + $COUNT = 2(0x2)
    7                                         + $I = 1(0x1)
    7  000a 00                       [ 4]     +     nop
    7  000b 21 01 00                 [10]     +   ld hl, $i
    8
